finding.classification: Required selected-current-native-issuer provenance correction, not an owner decision or a demand for whole worker execution
finding.title: Storage identity does not bind an accepted proof to the currently published generated authentication issuer
finding.cause: The proof record stores an issuer-local active flag and storage object. The reader accepts any still-active issuer using that object. Generated reinitialization invalidates only its own published host, and no reader comparison requires the proof issuer to be that currently selected host/generation.
finding.reproduction: Import unchanged generated factory, app and persistence. Initialize the real generated host and issue a real direct service key through declared storage. Construct a second native factory with the exact exported authenticationStorage, original real configuration/key and a resolver using actual generated resolveAuthenticationAuthority reads. Its proof is accepted. Failed generated initializeApplication invalidates the original host/proof and removes authenticationHost, yet the second host's existing and freshly minted proofs remain accepted. Successful rotation to a new key causes the current generated host to reject the old credential, while the second host's old-key proof still authorizes the owning transaction.
finding.impact_and_limits: This is a native trusted-host/current-configuration boundary gap, not a remote token-forgery claim. Both proofs really passed native HMAC and live declared authority checks; no invented standalone principal, rewritten renderer or raw-secret-bearing proof was used. Public job execution remains refused. The gap must be closed before this component is accepted as the selected generated worker issuer boundary.
finding.required_change: Require proof owner identity to equal the currently published generated authentication issuer/generation, in addition to storage identity, active status and verified facts. Use an opaque native host/issuer brand backed by a private registry or equivalent generated closure; do not accept a structural principal, host-shaped object, callback or authored setter as issuer identity. Generated initialization must clear the selected issuer before configuration work, publish only the successful current generation, and prevent stale initialization from restoring it. Preserve the pre-read and post-await proof checks and all existing database checks/locks.
finding.required_regression: Unpublished same-storage factory proofs must be rejected even while their crypto, records and storage are real; retain current-host success, foreign-storage/forged/clone rejection, failed and successful reinitialization/key-withdrawal controls, and reconfiguration during an awaited authority operation. This can be corrected without adding an ordinary grant or activating the worker.

bounded_assessment.native_proof_shape_and_crypto: Empty frozen null-prototype WeakMap proof, closed immutable facts, direct api-key HMAC/configured key and actual declared storage/authority reads; no random credential secret retained. Forged/clone/serialized/prototype/foreign-storage/signed-exchange negatives pass. Current-issuer selection remains WA-I01.
bounded_assessment.typed_lowering: Renderer borrows exact resolved identities through CheckedReminderDeliveryBinding.authority_for_lowering. No JSON-to-authority deserialization, public opaque constructor, ordinary role-union rewrite or public worker activation was introduced. This review does not reapprove the entire static binding checker.
bounded_assessment.selected_authority: Exact selected credential identity/principal/verifier/status/revocation/expiry, Service primary identity/name/active state, selected application membership/member/role and closed metadata equality are checked. No match-by-service-shape or observer role grant is used; duplicate selected membership is conservatively rejected.
bounded_assessment.owning_transaction: Active transaction assertion rejects standalone and expired clients. Nested client.transaction creates a native savepoint around the authority read, including digest/time validation. Actual SQL error controls recover surrounding Todo create/title update and schedule revision 1 on both adapters; false result and caught invalid proof cannot fabricate a permission grant.
bounded_assessment.locks_and_time: PostgreSQL FOR SHARE OF c,s,m,k is scoped to the actual source transaction. Existing native tests prove service disable waits on Lock until owning commit and expiry after a lock wait refuses admission. Independent no-op mutation probes additionally prove credential, selected membership and private metadata rows remain locked after authority savepoint release until owning commit. The AFTER-lock database time sample and final proof withdrawal check are present and tested; no post-admission reauthorization cut is added.
bounded_assessment.withdrawal_during_wait: Private probe delays completion of the actual native SHA-256 metadata digest, reinitializes the generated app while authority is awaiting it, then resumes the genuine digest result. Both adapters reject the original published-host proof with invalid_credentials. This confirms the final owner-active check for the current host, but cannot close WA-I01 for other same-store issuers.
bounded_assessment.public_and_metadata_guard: Exact renderer test asserts JADPO_TARGET_JOB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED before and after component rendering; emitted binding facts retain runtime_lowering_supported:false, live_authority_established:false, execution_profile:null.
